answer: Prayers & Duties >> Death & Funeral Question ID: 16665 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: Gayabana funeral prayer can pray or not? Question: Gayabana funeral prayer can pray or not? Answer ID: 16665 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1621/1286/L=1430) Having janazah in front is necessary for Janazah salah to be valid. It is not right to perform janazah in absence of janazah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
